name: tokensave-manager
description: Run TokenSave Manager checks, sync, doctor and test gaps from inside VS Code.

commands.title: Open this project in the Manager

tokensaveManager.managerPath.markdownDescription: **Recommended.** Path to your TokenSave Manager checkout or install. The extension then runs its live `src/cli.py` rather than a bundled binary, so it never goes stale, finds `manager-config.json` automatically, and can run `checks`.

tokensaveManager.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used with `managerPath`. Defaults to `python` on PATH.

tokensaveManager.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a built `tokensave-manager-cli.exe`. Takes precedence over `managerPath`. Leave empty unless you have no checkout — a compiled CLI is a snapshot and goes stale whenever the Manager changes.

tokensaveManager.configPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to `manager-config.json`, passed to the CLI as `--config`. **Not needed in source mode** — the CLI finds the config beside the checkout. Required only when running a relocated binary.

tokensaveManager.testGapsBase.markdownDescription: Git ref that Test Gaps compares against. `auto` asks the repository for its own default branch (`refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`), which is right whether it uses `main` or `master`. Set an explicit ref to override.

tokensaveManager.statusPollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often the status bar re-reads `status`, in seconds. Deliberately slow — file-system changes already trigger a (debounced) refresh, so this only catches changes made outside the editor.

tokensaveManager.statusDebounceMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait after a file change before refreshing the status bar. A branch switch fires many events at once; without this each one would spawn its own process to compute the same answer.

tokensaveManager.codeLens.markdownDescription: Annotate Python files with what the Manager knows about their tests. `source` marks modules with no filename-matched test file; `tests` shows each test file's count and any stale signals. The underlying scan is a **filename heuristic**, not coverage measurement, so it reports what was matched rather than claiming code is untested.

tokensaveManager.checksOnSave.markdownDescription: Run `checks` on a Python file when you save it, refreshing only that file's entries in the Problems panel. Debounced by `#tokensaveManager.statusDebounceMs#`. Needs a Manager checkout (`#tokensaveManager.managerPath#`) — the bundled CLI carries no Python interpreter to run the checks with.

action.description: The Manager operation to run. Stable identifiers from src/helpers/commands.py — these survive label changes.

viewsWelcome.contents:
TokenSave Manager needs to know where your Manager checkout is before it can do anything.
[Select the Manager folder](command:tokensaveManager.setManagerPath)
It looks for `src/cli.py` inside the folder you pick, and says so if it is not there.
[Open the walkthrough](command:tokensaveManager.openWalkthrough)

walkthroughs.title: Set up TokenSave Manager
walkthroughs.description: Point the extension at your Manager, check that it answers, and find the views it adds.

steps.title: Point at your Manager
steps.description:
Pick the folder containing `src/cli.py`. Source mode runs your live checkout rather than a compiled snapshot, so it never goes stale and `checks` works.
[Select the Manager folder](command:tokensaveManager.setManagerPath)

steps.title: Check that it answers
steps.description:
Runs the Manager's `commands` call and reports what came back. A path that looks right but cannot run is the state worth catching now rather than at the first real command.
[Verify the connection](command:tokensaveManager.verifySetup)

steps.title: Find the views
steps.description:
A Projects tree and a Savings panel in the activity bar, your tests in the Test Explorer, and the Manager's own dialogs in the command palette under **TokenSave Manager**.
[Open the Projects view](command:workbench.view.extension.tokensaveManager)
